text: Natural persons who are subject to AI systems for emotion recognition or biometric categorisation should be informed of the use of such systems. This is particularly important given the sensitive nature of the personal data involved and the heightened risks to the rights and freedoms of natural persons that such processing may entail. The disclosure obligation placed on deployers should ensure that natural persons are aware of the operation of the AI system and can exercise their rights under applicable Union law on the protection of personal data.
notes: Recital text is approximate; verify against OJ L 2024/1689. Grounds the Article 50(3) emotion recognition and biometric categorisation disclosure obligation.
